This game forces you to think in ways that you wouldnt typically think in another fps. for example instead of enemies just comming around the corners in like say counter strike. they might come through roof's or unsecured windows. Aside from that gunplay isnt something you havent seen before and the level design is (mostly) really good. Theres a certain satsfaction you get when you beat a enemy through tactics and smart choices instead of raw firepower. And for me no other shooter ive played gave me the same kind of feeling.

TLDR: uhhhh good shooter. Tactics and stuff. 10/10 Better than CSGO

Things I'm about to write down are not about me being not understanding the game or not good enough to enjoy it. This s*ittygame is here for almost seven years and I've been able to be part of it for four seasons. Day by day, the game made me disgusted with itself by being such a fan service. Unreasonable skins, unwanted map changes, meaningless brand new operators, and so on. The community became absolutely the same as the "CS" fandom and the toxicity&cheating been very common for the past three years. The last time I played "competitive" and "enthusiastic" was the Void Edge ep. I quit, hope this game rot like other disgusting, fan service ones.

Edit: 2025 Q4
It's worse now. Optimization is literally garbage. I get similar fps on the highest possible and the lowest possible settings. Gameplay feels much more choppy, sluggish, and the "QoL" updates are screwed up. Yet not enough, they killed the core mentality and soul of the game after releasing X. hAaAa SO IT'S F2P now. Hope you go bankrupt, Ubi.

Rainbow Six Siege is the game most other shooters wish to be. It combines skill and teamwork in order for a team to achieve the round victory.
This game is a real diamond in the world of First Person Shooters.

Pros:
-Extemely tactical gameplay.
-Encourages teamwork.
-Super cool and balanced characters.
-Lots of weapon customisation.
-Destructible walls.
-Extremely well done fortification system.
-Excellent Team-Based Swat Gameplay.
-Very Intensive Multiplayer combat.
-Very good Graphics.
-Stable 60+FPS.
-Very well optimized.
-Super Surround and Weapon Sounds.
-Stable Net performance and quick Matchmaking.
-Best "breach" feels.
-Master of tactics.
-Really strategic and unique type of a game.

I can not describe the "breach" adrenaline... is simply fantastic.
Best gun mechanics and movement physics ever.
Hats off to the best tactical First Person Shooter ever.
